text: Underway in match four!
Patchford orders Turingham to stay goal-side.
Patchford breaks clean through from the centre circle! Not a single yellow shirt in sight to protect the net!
Buffon.exe is clattered onto the deck by Patchford out wide.
Corner ram fires it clear.
Mbapp-E is unceremoniously flattened in the channel.
Patchford goes down point-blank!
Utter chaos for Dynamo as Buffon.exe crashes right into teammate Mbapp-E and hits the deck.
GOAL! Turingham taps it in from point-blank range to punish the defensive mix-up! Codex City take the lead, one nil!
Just wide of the target!
Patchford recalculates the wall bounce.
GOAL! Patchford smashes it home right at the goal mouth! Codex City double their advantage in seconds, it is Codex City two, Dynamo Datacenter nil!
Turingham surges straight up the middle into the attacking third, looking to extend this blistering start for the black shirts.
A whisker away from adding a third!
Patchford loses balance and tumbles right in front of goal, giving the yellow shirts a rare moment to breathe.
Buffon.exe steps forward into midfield on the left channel, trying to spark Dynamo into life.
Patchford comes flying in down the left channel, knocking Buffon.exe flat onto the carpet with a crunching challenge.
Buffon.exe charges through the middle, right on goal!
Turingham breaks out from deep! Nobody in front, a clear path down the pitch for Codex City!
Turingham drives forward through the centre.
Agonisingly close off the post!
Patchford calls out an angle calculation to work the rebound off the wall.
GOAL! Patchford converts from the left channel! That is three for Codex City, cruising at three nil!
Mbapp-E is sent sprawling!
Teammates collide again, Buffon.exe falls!
Buffon.exe scrambles up and immediately drives through the centre into shooting range, desperate to claw something back.
Flashing just past the upright from distance.
Mbapp-E loses footing right in front of the goal mouth, an unfortunate slip at a crucial moment for Dynamo.
The powered push-panel in the corner shoots the ball back into play along the right touchline.
Mbapp-E signals the plan to prise the ball off the boards in the final third.
Relentless pressure here from Codex City, hemming Dynamo inside their own half for eleven straight seconds.
Mbapp-E bursts clean through on goal with nobody in yellow or black between them and the net!
GOAL! Buffon.exe is there at the mouth of the goal to poke it home! Dynamo Datacenter pull one back, three one!
Patchford topples over in space.
Buffon.exe floors Turingham with a firm tackle out wide.
That brings us to the break. Codex City lead Dynamo Datacenter three goals to one in a frantic opening half.
Patchford loses gyroscopic stability in the centre circle and takes a tumble.
So close to a fourth for Codex as the shot skims just past the left upright.
Dynamo pin Codex deep back.
GOAL! Mbapp-E bundles it over the line point-blank! Dynamo Datacenter are right back in this at three two!
Buffon.exe is clean through from midfield with open goal ahead!
Patchford communicates the trajectory solution to bounce it off the perimeter wall.
GOAL! Buffon.exe levels the match right on the goal line! What a comeback, three three!
Turingham alerts the backline to step up and meet the danger.
Buffon.exe powers five metres through the middle, carrying the fight into the Codex third.
Mbapp-E clean through down the right touchline!
A dreadful mix-up between Codex teammates as Turingham crashes into Patchford and falls!
Dynamo Datacenter have completely turned the tide, keeping Codex City under suffocating pressure for eleven relentless seconds.
Turingham confirms the assignment to cover the ball-side lane while the press steps up.
Codex City are pinned inside their own territory once again as Dynamo search for a winner.
Turingham signals to maintain that defensive lane in midfield.
GOAL! Patchford pounces from close range to restore the lead! Heartbreak for Dynamo as Codex City make it four three!
Mbapp-E charges six metres along the right touchline, driving Dynamo forward for one last roll of the dice.
Just wide of the post!
GOAL! An own goal from Turingham! Another defensive disaster this season! It is four four at the death!
Full time in a four-all classic, honours even in a thrilling encounter.
